claim.en: The CORDIS objective describes integrating simulation assets and real-time data through a federated architecture. An objective is not proof that every proposed module or decision workflow is operational.
claim.zh: CORDIS 项目目标介绍了通过联邦式架构集成仿真资产与实时数据；目标本身不能证明所有拟议模块与决策流程均已投入运行。

claim.en: IEA distinguishes physical electricity supply from operators' contractual mix. Its system-level analysis does not identify a dedicated FOWT-to-AI contract in this collection.
claim.zh: IEA 区分实际供电与运营商的合同采购组合；本资料集中的系统层面分析未识别具体浮式风电到 AI 的专用合同。
